target_customer: B2B sales teams selling to data-scarce SMB markets, including enterprises such as L'Oreal and Saint-Gobain
problem: Standard lead databases miss most small businesses, so sales teams cannot find or qualify them.
business_model: Per-user SaaS subscription (free, 100 and 400 USD per user per month tiers, custom enterprise) with forward-deployed engineers
product_category: AI lead qualification and sales intelligence

founders.name: Ludovic Granger
founders.background_notes: Built a community of 300 sales reps.

founders.name: Milan Stankovic
previous_startups: Earlier company (YC page says previous exit; details not found)
founders.background_notes: Reported to have over 60 scientific publications.

competitors.name: Clay
competitors.what: Data enrichment and GTM workflow tool
competitors.traction_then: Widely used GTM tool; figures not found

competitors.name: Apollo
competitors.traction_then: 210 million contacts per a rival comparison page

technical_complexity.rationale: Lookalike prediction on sparse data and extrapolation of missing company data is real ML work but built on known methods.

defensibility.rationale: Value comes from models trained on each customer's won and lost history and CRM integrations; core idea is replicable by data vendors with larger databases.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents and many AI SDR tools were already shipping lead qualification features; no Leadbay-specific response found.

market_need_then: Founders cite incumbents missing roughly 70 percent of US companies; customers report 3x addressable market. These are company claims, unverified.

branding.domain_note: Uses leadbay.ai; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Casual, with a rock-on emoji after the name and quoted customer line about ten minutes beating six months with Clay and an agency

branding.brand_signature: The customer quote contrasting 10 minutes on Leadbay with 6 months on Clay and a GTM agency

brand_strength.rationale: Young brand; press is funding coverage only and a name that resembles many lead-gen names.

outcome_analysis: Leadbay entered YC in Fall 2025 with named European enterprise customers and raised a reported 4.3 million dollar seed in May 2026. It is early and active; success rests on an ML founder and a niche in data-scarce SMB markets, while crowded incumbents are the main threat.
notes: Seed reported as 4.2M or 4.3M (also 3.8M EUR); lead investor conflicts across outlets. CB Insights shows an earlier 0.5M convertible note in Oct 2025 seen only on one aggregator, unverified. Founded year not found (aggregators say 2023, unverified). Name origin not found.
